changeSet.author: lars
changeSet.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW rpt_work_order_cost AS SELECT wo.id AS work_order_id, wo.company_id, COALESCE(labor_stats.labor_cost, 0) AS labor_cost, COALESCE(labor_stats.labor_seconds, 0) AS labor_seconds, ROUND(COALESCE(labor_stats.labor_seconds, 0) / 3600.0, 2) AS labor_hours, COALESCE(part_stats.part_cost, 0) AS part_cost, COALESCE(add_stats.additional_cost, 0) AS additional_cost, COALESCE(part_stats.part_cost, 0) + COALESCE(add_stats.additional_cost, 0) AS total_cost_excl_labor, COALESCE(labor_stats.labor_cost, 0) + COALESCE(part_stats.part_cost, 0) + COALESCE(add_stats.additional_cost, 0) AS total_cost_incl_labor FROM work_order wo LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.work_order_id, SUM(l.hourly_rate * l.duration / 3600) AS labor_cost, SUM(l.duration) AS labor_seconds FROM labor l GROUP BY l.work_order_id) labor_stats ON labor_stats.work_order_id = wo.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT pq.work_order_id, SUM(p.cost * pq.quantity) AS part_cost FROM part_quantity pq JOIN part p ON pq.part_id = p.id GROUP BY pq.work_order_id) part_stats ON part_stats.work_order_id = wo.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT ac.work_order_id, SUM(ac.cost) AS additional_cost FROM additional_cost ac GROUP BY ac.work_order_id) add_stats ON add_stats.work_order_id = wo.id;
COMMENT ON VIEW rpt_work_order_cost IS 'Reporting: cost and logged-time components per work order. Mirrors WorkOrderRepository.findTotalWOCosts, including its integer truncation of labour cost.';

changeSet.author: lars
changeSet.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW rpt_custom_field_value AS SELECT cfv.id, cf.entity_type, COALESCE(cfv.work_order_id, cfv.asset_id, cfv.location_id, cfv.part_id, cfv.meter_id, cfv.customer_id, cfv.vendor_id, cfv.preventive_maintenance_id, cfv.request_id) AS entity_id, cfv.work_order_id, cfv.asset_id, cfv.location_id, cf.id AS custom_field_id, cf.label, cf.field_type, cf.unit, cs.company_id, cfv.value AS value_text, CASE WHEN cf.field_type = 'NUMBER' AND cfv.value ~ '^\s*-?[0-9]+([.,][0-9]+)?\s*$' THEN REPLACE(TRIM(cfv.value), ',', '.')::numeric END AS value_number, CASE WHEN cf.field_type IN ('DATE', 'DATE_TIME') AND cfv.value ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}' THEN SUBSTRING(cfv.value, 1, 10)::date END AS value_date, cfv.created_at, cfv.updated_at FROM custom_field_value cfv JOIN custom_field cf ON cfv.custom_field_id = cf.id LEFT JOIN company_settings cs ON cf.company_settings_id = cs.id;
COMMENT ON VIEW rpt_custom_field_value IS 'Reporting: custom field values in long form with type-guarded numeric and date columns. company_id comes via custom_field -> company_settings.';

changeSet.author: lars
changeSet.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW rpt_work_order AS SELECT wo.id, wo.company_id, c.name AS company_name, wo.custom_id, wo.title, wo.description, CASE wo.status WHEN 0 THEN 'OPEN' WHEN 1 THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' WHEN 2 THEN 'ON_HOLD' WHEN 3 THEN 'COMPLETE' END AS status, CASE wo.priority WHEN 0 THEN 'NONE' WHEN 1 THEN 'LOW' WHEN 2 THEN 'MEDIUM' WHEN 3 THEN 'HIGH' END AS priority, wo.archived, wo.is_demo, wo.required_signature, wo.feedback, -- relations, resolved wo.asset_id, a.name AS asset_name, a.custom_id AS asset_custom_id, ac.name AS asset_category, wo.location_id, loc.name AS location_name, wo.category_id, cat.name AS category_name, wo.team_id, tm.name AS team_name, wo.primary_user_id, TRIM(COALESCE(pu.first_name, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(pu.last_name, '')) AS primary_user_name, pu.email AS primary_user_email, wo.completed_by_id, TRIM(COALESCE(cb.first_name, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(cb.last_name, '')) AS completed_by_name, cb.email AS completed_by_email, assignees.emails AS assigned_to_emails, COALESCE(assignees.assignee_count, 0) AS assigned_to_count, wo.parent_request_id, wo.parent_preventive_maintenance_id, -- dates wo.created_at, wo.updated_at, COALESCE(pr.created_at, wo.created_at) AS real_created_at, wo.due_date, wo.estimated_start_date, wo.completed_on, wo.first_time_to_react, -- derived (wo.status = 3) AS is_complete, (wo.parent_preventive_maintenance_id IS NULL) AS is_reactive, (wo.due_date IS NULL OR (wo.completed_on IS NOT NULL AND wo.completed_on < wo.due_date)) AS is_compliant, (wo.status <> 3 AND wo.due_date IS NOT NULL AND wo.due_date < (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')) AS is_overdue, wo.estimated_duration AS estimated_hours, ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (wo.first_time_to_react - wo.created_at)) / 3600.0, 2) AS reaction_hours, FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (wo.completed_on - COALESCE(pr.created_at, wo.created_at))) / 86400.0)::int AS cycle_time_days, CASE WHEN wo.status <> 3 THEN FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - COALESCE(pr.created_at, wo.created_at))) / 86400.0)::int END AS open_age_days, -- costs and time cost.labor_cost, cost.labor_hours, cost.part_cost, cost.additional_cost, cost.total_cost_excl_labor, cost.total_cost_incl_labor, -- custom fields as label -> value. Not aliased `values` anywhere below: VALUES is a -- fully reserved word in Postgres and cannot be a column label even after AS. COALESCE(cfields.field_values, '{}'::jsonb) AS custom_fields FROM work_order wo LEFT JOIN company c ON wo.company_id = c.id LEFT JOIN asset a ON wo.asset_id = a.id LEFT JOIN asset_category ac ON a.category_id = ac.id LEFT JOIN location loc ON wo.location_id = loc.id LEFT JOIN work_order_category cat ON wo.category_id = cat.id LEFT JOIN team tm ON wo.team_id = tm.id LEFT JOIN own_user pu ON wo.primary_user_id = pu.id LEFT JOIN own_user cb ON wo.completed_by_id = cb.id LEFT JOIN request pr ON wo.parent_request_id = pr.id LEFT JOIN rpt_work_order_cost cost ON cost.work_order_id = wo.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT wau.work_order_id, STRING_AGG(u.email, ', ' ORDER BY u.email) AS emails, COUNT(*) AS assignee_count FROM work_order_assigned_to wau JOIN own_user u ON wau.assigned_to_id = u.id GROUP BY wau.work_order_id) assignees ON assignees.work_order_id = wo.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT v.work_order_id, JSONB_OBJECT_AGG(v.label, v.value_text) AS field_values FROM rpt_custom_field_value v WHERE v.work_order_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY v.work_order_id) cfields ON cfields.work_order_id = wo.id;
COMMENT ON VIEW rpt_work_order IS 'Reporting: one row per work order with labelled enums, resolved relations, derived KPIs and costs. Filter on company_id.';

changeSet.author: lars
changeSet.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW rpt_asset AS SELECT a.id, a.company_id, a.custom_id, a.name, a.description, CASE a.status WHEN 0 THEN 'OPERATIONAL' WHEN 1 THEN 'DOWN' WHEN 2 THEN 'MODERNIZATION' WHEN 3 THEN 'STANDBY' WHEN 4 THEN 'INSPECTION_SCHEDULED' WHEN 5 THEN 'COMMISSIONING' WHEN 6 THEN 'EMERGENCY_SHUTDOWN' END AS status, (a.status IN (1, 6)) AS is_down, a.archived, a.area, a.model, a.manufacturer, a.power, a.serial_number, a.bar_code, a.nfc_id, a.acquisition_cost, a.in_service_date, a.warranty_expiration_date, (a.warranty_expiration_date IS NOT NULL AND a.warranty_expiration_date < (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')) AS warranty_expired, CASE WHEN a.in_service_date IS NOT NULL THEN FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - a.in_service_date)) / 86400.0)::int END AS service_age_days, a.category_id, cat.name AS category_name, a.location_id, loc.name AS location_name, a.parent_asset_id, parent.name AS parent_asset_name, a.primary_user_id, TRIM(COALESCE(pu.first_name, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(pu.last_name, '')) AS primary_user_name, a.created_at, a.updated_at, -- work order rollup COALESCE(wo_roll.work_orders, 0) AS work_orders, COALESCE(wo_roll.open_work_orders, 0) AS open_work_orders, COALESCE(wo_roll.overdue_work_orders, 0) AS overdue_work_orders, COALESCE(wo_roll.reactive_work_orders, 0) AS reactive_work_orders, wo_roll.last_completed_on, COALESCE(wo_roll.labor_cost, 0) AS labor_cost, COALESCE(wo_roll.part_cost, 0) AS part_cost, COALESCE(wo_roll.additional_cost, 0) AS additional_cost, COALESCE(wo_roll.total_cost_incl_labor, 0) AS total_maintenance_cost, COALESCE(wo_roll.labor_hours, 0) AS labor_hours, -- downtime COALESCE(dt.downtime_events, 0) AS downtime_events, ROUND(COALESCE(dt.downtime_seconds, 0) / 3600.0, 2) AS downtime_hours, COALESCE(cfields.field_values, '{}'::jsonb) AS custom_fields FROM asset a LEFT JOIN asset_category cat ON a.category_id = cat.id LEFT JOIN location loc ON a.location_id = loc.id LEFT JOIN asset parent ON a.parent_asset_id = parent.id LEFT JOIN own_user pu ON a.primary_user_id = pu.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT w.asset_id, COUNT(*) AS work_orders, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT w.is_complete) AS open_work_orders, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE w.is_overdue) AS overdue_work_orders, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE w.is_reactive) AS reactive_work_orders, MAX(w.completed_on) AS last_completed_on, SUM(w.labor_cost) AS labor_cost, SUM(w.part_cost) AS part_cost, SUM(w.additional_cost) AS additional_cost, SUM(w.total_cost_incl_labor) AS total_cost_incl_labor, SUM(w.labor_hours) AS labor_hours FROM rpt_work_order w WHERE w.asset_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT w.archived GROUP BY w.asset_id) wo_roll ON wo_roll.asset_id = a.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT d.asset_id, COUNT(*) AS downtime_events, SUM(d.duration) AS downtime_seconds FROM asset_downtime d GROUP BY d.asset_id) dt ON dt.asset_id = a.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT v.asset_id, JSONB_OBJECT_AGG(v.label, v.value_text) AS field_values FROM rpt_custom_field_value v WHERE v.asset_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY v.asset_id) cfields ON cfields.asset_id = a.id;
COMMENT ON VIEW rpt_asset IS 'Reporting: one row per asset with work-order and downtime rollups. Filter on company_id.';
